tools.name: demand_intent
tools.description: For one intent in plain words (e.g. weather forecast, pypi package info) returns the sellers on the x402 market, their price, 30-day calls and unique paying wallets. Free.

tools.name: find_paid_api
tools.description: Describe what an agent needs (e.g. 'weather alerts', 'sec filings', 'token safety'). Returns pay-per-call HTTP APIs (x402 / MPP) that answered a valid 402 payment request seconds ago, with price, network and payTo, cheapest first. Dead listings are dropped. Free; nothing is paid or stored.

tools.name: check_x402_origin
tools.description: Free readiness check of an x402/MPP seller origin you operate or want to evaluate: openapi.json, declared paid operations, whether each answers a valid 402, price parity, MPP realm. Reads public URLs only; pays nothing.
